protocol.estimator: PathMI (horseshoe ranking, Laplace marginal-likelihood walk, log Bayes factor per patient), v_beta = 1, 2000 Gibbs iterations, 500 burn-in, thin 10
protocol.uncertainty: half-sampling, B = 50 label-stratified half-cohort subsamples with the projection refitted, delete-d jackknife s.e.
protocol.usable: ridge logistic, stratified 5-fold x 10 repeats, standardisation, projection and penalty fitted in training patients only
protocol.selection: configuration chosen as the largest of the 16 pooling x projection estimates on the full cohort; the sampling interval and the usable recoverability are conditional on the configuration and do not account for its selection
protocol.detection: permutation_p: fixed-arm null of the recorded configuration; p_max16: joint-permutation maximum over the 16 configurations of this model-state pair (adjusts detection within the pair, not across pairs, and does not correct the magnitude of the selected estimate)
protocol.numerical_tolerance: empirical and protocol-specific: largest discrepancy over replicate refits and sign-flip refits within the model group; not a universal error bound; does not cover the chain-seed instability of CONCH v1.5 polynomial/moment MSI (0.032 to 0.104 nats)
protocol.evidence_rule: resolved if Ihat - 1.645 s.e. > I_null + epsilon_rep, with I_null the fixed-arm permutation null; an operational classification of evidence sufficiency under this protocol, not a calibrated confidence procedure for population mutual information
protocol.tile_burden_readout: fixed mean-pooling, linear-PCA readout of the model (not necessarily the recorded configuration); tiles needed to retain a fraction of its whole-slide in-sample plug-in log-score gain

evidence.N_evidence: not resolved at the evaluated sample sizes
evidence.N_evidence_definition: smallest evaluated sample size satisfying the operational resolution criterion (grid 50, 100, 150, 200, floor(N/2), N)

supported_interpretations: the protocol returns no recoverability above its resolution criterion under permuted labels (negative control)
interpretations_not_established: any statement about the molecular state, since the labels are permuted
